info.title: KR Homebase API
info.description: Generated from the route definitions. Do not edit by hand; run `pnpm openapi`.

get.summary: Report that the API Worker is running and which version answered.
get.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: None.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: INTERNAL_ERROR.

get.summary: Return the public settings the login card needs.
get.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Outside tools: not allowed.

firmName.description: Firm name shown on the login card.

post.summary: Check the Cloudflare human-check token and remember a pass for five minutes.
post.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: Calls Cloudflare Turnstile siteverify; Sets the kr_turnstile_verified cookie.

Outside tools: not allowed.

token.description: The one-time token the Turnstile widget gave the browser.

verified.description: Always true; a failed check is an error reply.

hostname.description: Host name Cloudflare saw the widget on.

action.description: Action label the widget was rendered with.

422.description: The request did not match the contract (VALIDATION_FAILED).

get.summary: Send the browser to Google to sign in.
get.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: Sets the OAuth state and nonce cookies; Clears the Turnstile pass cookie.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: INTERNAL_ERROR.

302.description: Redirect to Google, or to /login?auth_error=<code> when sign-in cannot start.

get.summary: Finish Google sign-in: check the answer, admit the person and open a session.
get.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: Calls Google (token exchange and signing keys); Calls the CRUD Worker: reads user, user_sso_identity, user_invite; writes individual, individual_contact_method, user, user_sso_identity, user_invite, employee, kr_session, kr_homebase_initialization; Sets the session cookie.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED, INTERNAL_ERROR.

schema.description: The state value Google sends back.

parameters.description: The state value Google sends back.
parameters.name: state

schema.description: Google error code when the person declined or Google refused.

parameters.description: Google error code when the person declined or Google refused.
parameters.name: error

302.description: Redirect to / when signed in, or to /login?auth_error=<code>.

422.description: The request did not match the contract (VALIDATION_FAILED).

get.summary: Return the signed-in person for the current session cookie.
get.description:
Any signed-in user.

Side effects: Updates last_seen_at on the session through the Session Worker.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, SESSION_VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR.

displayName.description: Name to show for the person.

role.description: Role stored on the user account.

firmName.description: Firm name for the account block.

avatarInitials.description: Two to four letters for the avatar circle.

mfaVerified.description: True when a second step was already satisfied.

503.description: The session check is not available (SESSION_VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE).

delete.summary: Log out: clear the session cookie and close the session.
delete.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: Clears the session cookie; Marks the kr_session row revoked through the CRUD Worker (best effort).

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: INTERNAL_ERROR.

loggedOut.description: Always true. The cookie is cleared and the session is closed when it could be found.

schema.description: Any date in the wanted pay period (firm-local YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

parameters.description: Any date in the wanted pay period (firm-local YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

parameters.description: The employee whose card to show. Default: the signed-in person's own. Another employee needs the team or all scope.
parameters.name: employeeId

today.description: Today in the firm time zone.

start.description: First day (a Sunday with the default anchor).

number.description: Period number within the year of its end date (1 = the first period ending in January).

status.description: Stored status (`open`, ...), or null when no punch has created the period row yet.

payDate.description: Pay date when one is stored (none is today).

period.description: The pay period holding the requested date.

name.description: First and last name, else the login email.

isLocked.description: True when locked, approved or exported: no punch or entry may change.

employeeApprovedByUserId.description: Who approved it for the employee.

managerApprovedAt.description: When a manager or super admin approved it.

card.description: The stored card, or null when no punch or entry has created it yet.

occurredAt.description: When, rounded to the reporting increment.

supersedesPunchId.description: The punch this one replaced (a correction).

voidedAt.description: Set when the punch was removed. Voided punches are kept for the record and never counted.

punches.description: Every punch on the card in time order, voided ones included (marked).

startPunchId.description: The clock-in (or, for a clock-out without a clock-in, the clock-out).

endPunchId.description: The clock-out, or null when none closed it.

endAt.description: End; for an unclosed clock-in, the next local midnight (a stand-in, never paid).

isAssumedMidnightClose.description: True when the end is a stand-in, not a real clock-out.

exception.description: A problem with this pair, or null.

intervals.description: The punches paired into worked spans.

timeType.description: `pto`, `holiday`, `sick`, `unpaid` or `other`. Regular time comes from the punches.

events.description: Hand-entered hours (PTO, holiday, sick, unpaid, other) in the period.

regularHours.description: From real in and out pairs, up to 40 a week.

overtimeHours.description: Computed: hours over 40 in a Sunday-to-Saturday week. Stored overtime entries never count.

totals.description: Hours by category for the period.

exceptions.description: Each kind of pairing problem on the card, once.

isCardEditWindowExpired.description: True when the period ended longer ago than the viewer's window.

incrementMinutes.description: Punches and hours are rounded to this many minutes (6 = a tenth of an hour).

employeeEditWindowDays.description: Days after the work date an employee may still change their own punches.

managerEditWindowDays.description: Days after the work date a manager may still change a team member's punches.

policy.description: The policy values the screen needs.

scope.description: Why the viewer may see this card: their own, a team member's, or everyone's.

canUpdate.description: May change hand-entered hours and notes on this card (window and lock still apply).

canEditPunches.description: May add, change or remove punches on this card. An employee on leave may enter hours but not punches.

isSuperAdmin.description: Super admin: bypasses the edit windows and sees the correction history.

editWindowDays.description: The window that applies to this viewer on this card.

viewer.description: What the signed-in person may do with this card.

kind.description: `employee` on one's own card, `manager` on someone else's, null when the viewer may not approve.

allowed.description: True when the Approve button may be pressed now.

blockedReason.description: Why approval is not possible now, in a plain sentence (null when allowed or not offered).

canReopen.description: True when the viewer may reopen this card now (it is submitted or approved, and the viewer is a manager of it or a super admin).

approval.description: Whether and how the viewer may approve or reopen this card now.

403.description: No Attendance access, not set up as an employee, or not allowed to see this employee.

404.description: No such employee (EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND).

422.description: The date is not a real calendar date (VALIDATION_INVALID_DATE).
